name: Princeton ModelNet40: 3D CAD Object Classification Benchmark
description: Princeton ModelNet40 is an established benchmark for 3D computer vision and CAD shape classification. Originating from the 3D ShapeNets project, ModelNet40 comprises 12,311 clean, 3D polygonal CAD models manually classified into 40 common object categories (e.g., airplane, chair, guitar, sofa, table), benchmarked extensively across point-cloud classifiers, voxel networks, and multi-view 2D rendering systems.
